description: Source code for the Firefox browser type implementation in Playwright, including methods for launching, connecting, environment setup, and logging.

classes.name: Firefox
classes.description: Represents the Firefox browser type with methods to launch, connect, and manage Firefox browser instances.

methods.name: launch
methods.description: Launches a new Firefox browser instance with specified options.

methods.name: launchPersistentContext
methods.description: Creates a persistent browser context with user data directory.

methods.name: connectToTransport
methods.description: Connects to a Firefox browser instance via transport.

methods.name: doRewriteStartupLog
methods.description: Rewrites startup logs to include helpful messages or workarounds.

methods.name: amendEnvironment
methods.description: Modifies environment variables for launching Firefox.

methods.name: attemptToGracefullyCloseBrowser
methods.description: Sends a message to close the browser gracefully.

methods.name: defaultArgs
methods.description: Generates default command-line arguments for launching Firefox.

methods.name: waitForReadyState
methods.description: Waits for the browser to be ready, listening for specific log messages.
